about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.status: Board reinstated Huang as CEO on 23 Nov citing US government input; Kress back to CFO; internal probe, SEC, FBI, DoJ, California AG and House inquiries continue.
Burnham reported the 20 Nov Brussels package to MPs on 23 Nov; SPS checks mostly end 1 Mar 2028; European Partnerships Bill vote due before Christmas recess.
Iran vows all available means against US blockade; Trump says all recent drones and missiles were downed; Qatari delegation held talks in Tehran on 20 Nov.
Zelensky on 23 Nov called for four-way talks with Russia, Europe and US; partners want them before Christmas; UAE floated as venue.
Likud and Yashar ended a second round without a deal on 22 Nov; Eisenkot's bloc has 48 seats; deadline 6 Dec plus possible 14 days.
Exploited unauthenticated root RCE in clustered Expressway; fixed in X15.5.20; on CISA KEV since 20 Nov; Cisco advisory not yet read.
Qatar GP 27-29 Nov (race Sun 16:00 UK); stewards' consistency row after Hamilton's Las Vegas penalty; Cadillac reportedly kept Bottas with Perez for 2027 (18 Nov, not yet covered).
Brazil package carries the 2027 front-wing concept; McLaren took second and third in Las Vegas on 22 Nov.
Z.ai GLM-5.4 (750B, looped layers) out to coding subscribers on 23 Nov; weights and benchmarks pending.
Lean artifact of about 17 million lines community-certified 21 Nov with checks outstanding; mathematical explanation pending.
Dragos canary research found leaks at three or more providers; OpenRouter removed 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention; Together AI disclosed a separate credential leak.
Reported deadline Wed 25 Nov; administration possible if talks fail; around 11,000 to 12,000 jobs at risk depending on report.
25-26 Nov strike in England paused on 11 Nov for formal pay and conditions talks; BMA warns of further action if talks stall.
Honda had no root cause for Stroll's battery failures as of 13 Nov; full fix targeted for 2027.
OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol launched 17 Nov (not yet covered) with tighter cyber safeguards on Astra; Gemini 4 Neon launched 18 Nov.
